entries.title: Narrator: "I walked down the palm-tree-lined p..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked down the palm-tree-lined path that connected Palas Rezna to the nearby House of Delegates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In contrast to the ornate palace, t..."
entries.dialogueText: In contrast to the ornate palace, the House was essentially a plain concrete box. Its stripped-down appearance reflected its hurried construction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The only adornment was a phrase chi..."
entries.dialogueText: The only adornment was a phrase chiseled above the entrance: "Ax Populat Rizati."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""To the Rizian People.""
entries.dialogueText: "To the Rizian People."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I made my way down the hall to the..."
entries.dialogueText: I made my way down the hall to the meeting room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo rose to greet me as I entered..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo rose to greet me as I entered the empty chamber. We took our seats atop the raised wooden platform in the center of the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Directly below the platform were tw..."
entries.dialogueText: Directly below the platform were two podiums, one for each speaker. Wooden benches for the delegates were arranged in a circle around us.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Welcome, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Welcome, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How are you, Hugo?""
entries.dialogueText: "How are you, Hugo?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good morning, Your Grace.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The clock struck ten and the delega..."
entries.dialogueText: The clock struck ten and the delegates filed in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Each wore a satin sash in the tradi..."
entries.dialogueText: Each wore a satin sash in the traditional color of his or her province: red for Rizia Imperii, blue for Valenqiris, yellow for Cardesse-Montaklar and green for Brenas.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Next came the speakers. House Leade..."
entries.dialogueText: Next came the speakers. House Leader Daria de Rava walked out in a well-tailored crimson suit.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You said she's a loyalist.""
entries.dialogueText: "You said she's a loyalist."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Which house does she belong to aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which house does she belong to again?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Quite right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Quite right."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The de Ravas aren't related to any..."
entries.dialogueText: "The de Ravas aren't related to any of the royal houses. They were granted their nobility status through service to our family after the War of Succession."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remind me, how did she land this j..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remind me, how did she land this job?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Technically, she's a Baroness. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Technically, she's a Baroness. But she prefers the title of Madam Speaker."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""She performed superbly as the head..."
entries.dialogueText: "She performed superbly as the head of the provincial council in Rizia Imperii."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I noted the approving tone in his v..."
entries.dialogueText: I noted the approving tone in his voice as he spoke of her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Next came Manus Sazon, clad in a bl..."
entries.dialogueText: Next came Manus Sazon, clad in a black suit with a forest-green silk tie. He waved to his fellow delegates, then to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I returned his wave. He smiled as h..."
entries.dialogueText: I returned his wave. He smiled as he took his place.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't move as he took his place."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't move as he took his place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria picked up a golden bell and r..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria picked up a golden bell and rang it once.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Ladies and gentlemen, it is my pri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen, it is my privilege to call this meeting of the House of Delegates to order."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Today we are humbled by the presen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today we are humbled by the presence of His Majesty King Romus, long may he reign."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few cries of "Long may he reign!"..."
entries.dialogueText: A few cries of "Long may he reign!" echoed among the delegates, particularly those in red and blue sashes.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The Rizian People's Party has prep..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian People's Party has prepared a proposal that Mr. Sazon will submit before the Delegates and His Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Mr. Sazon, would you like to expla..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon, would you like to explain more?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Gladly, Madam Speaker.""
entries.dialogueText: "Gladly, Madam Speaker."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The past two decades have seen a m..."
entries.dialogueText: "The past two decades have seen a marked increase in workplace accidents, particularly in the sectors of mining and manufacturing."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Now a cross-industry coalition of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now a cross-industry coalition of employees has bravely approached the Rizian People's Party with a list of requests to convey to our fellow delegates as well as His Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Among these are standardized workp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Among these are standardized workplace safety protocols, upgraded protective equipment, benefits for those injured on the job, and regular site inspections by state authorities."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Madam Speaker, Your Majesty, surel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Madam Speaker, Your Majesty, surely you agree on the urgency of this proposition. Rizia's great industries will not flourish as long as our workers are suffering."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at Hugo."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at Hugo.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is an honor to be here, Madam S..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is an honor to be here, Madam Speaker."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Say that louder.""
entries.dialogueText: "Say that louder."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am here to serve you, esteemed d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am here to serve you, esteemed delegates. I look forward to your recommendations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I let her continue."
entries.dialogueText: I let her continue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hall reverberated with full-thr..."
entries.dialogueText: The hall reverberated with full-throated cries of "LONG MAY HE REIGN!" Daria smiled and continued.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled and continued."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled and continued.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The Delegates will vote on whether..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Delegates will vote on whether to accept or reject it, but this is a non-binding recommendation. The ultimate authority rests with the King and the Royal Council."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So Rusty was right. The RPP took u..."
entries.dialogueText: "So Rusty was right. The RPP took up the workers' cause."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How does he expect us to pay for a..."
entries.dialogueText: "How does he expect us to pay for all this?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's hard to believe we had none o..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's hard to believe we had none of these measures in place before now."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Mr. Montoro will be expecting you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro will be expecting you to make good on your assurance to him. But of course, you're under no obligation to do so."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This is why I never brought these..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is why I never brought these meetings to your attention before. The proposals are impractical at best and ruinous at worst."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And yet our industries flourished..."
entries.dialogueText: "And yet our industries flourished nonetheless."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I suddenly realized the hall had go..."
entries.dialogueText: I suddenly realized the hall had gone quiet.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Shall I continue?""
entries.dialogueText: "Shall I continue?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please go on. I didn't mean to int..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please go on. I didn't mean to interrupt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard enough from the RPP. I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard enough from the RPP. I'd like to know what Ms. de Rava thinks about the Workers' Protection Act."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Of course my party believes that w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course my party believes that worker safety is paramount. But the regulations that have been suggested today amount to overkill."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Furthermore, they already see empl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, they already see employee safety as their responsibility. Shifting that responsibility to the government will do nothing to protect those at risk."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""It will, however, stifle our econo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will, however, stifle our economic growth and decrease our viability in the global arena."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""My point stands. With tensions ris..."
entries.dialogueText: "My point stands. With tensions rising in both our north and south, we simply cannot afford an extravagance of the type Mr. Sazon is proposing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From near the front door came the s..."
entries.dialogueText: From near the front door came the sound of a single person applauding.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""My point stands. Rizia's gold and..."
entries.dialogueText: "My point stands. Rizia's gold and gas income is far from guaranteed at this moment."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Busy as usual, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Busy as usual, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The delegates will be on their bes..."
entries.dialogueText: "The delegates will be on their best behavior with you here today."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She had a brisk gait and impeccable..."
entries.dialogueText: She had a brisk gait and impeccable posture. The other delegates practically held their breath as they waited for her to take her place.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""In all of the sessions I've attend..."
entries.dialogueText: "In all of the sessions I've attended, she has never made a decision that didn't align with the interests of the noble houses."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's now her third term as speaker..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's now her third term as speaker. I do not believe she intends to vacate the position."

entries.dialogueText: "Today's session is regarding the Rizian Workers' Protection Act."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Now. The Rizian Standard Dictionar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now. The Rizian Standard Dictionary defines 'gold' as a yellow precious metal, used in jewelry and to guarantee the value of currencies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There will be no bloviating in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "There will be no bloviating in these chambers, *Rusty*."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, we are all familiar with the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we are all familiar with the substance in question."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent as he continued.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But in Rizia, it's so much more. C..."
entries.dialogueText: "But in Rizia, it's so much more. Commoners who've never even touched a ducat still feel proud to live 'on shores of gold', as we sing."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Fair enough, Your Majesty. Mr. Saz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough, Your Majesty. Mr. Sazon over there has done enough bloviating for all of us put together."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But our shores would never have be..."
entries.dialogueText: "But our shores would never have been golden in the first place if our monarchs had listened to naysayers like Mr. Sazon here."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Your Majesty, your predecessors kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, your predecessors knew that there can be no prosperity without hard work. Our grit and determination today fills the nation's coffers tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But where does that grit go when t..."
entries.dialogueText: "But where does that grit go when the government's got our hands tied? How can we function as a company when you folks don't trust us to take care of our own people?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If I may ask, sir, how exactly wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I may ask, sir, how exactly would our proposal tie your hands? What is so difficult about regulating safety in gold mines?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Don't play dumb, kid. You know eac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't play dumb, kid. You know each mining site in Rizia is as unique as a birthmark on the Archpriest of Deyr's behind."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""They would be paid for in equal me..."
entries.dialogueText: "They would be paid for in equal measure by the government and the corporations in question."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Mr. Montoro, I assume you are here..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro, I assume you are here as a representative of RRG as well as Rizia's business community as a whole. Is it safe to say your fellow executives share your opinion on the RPP's proposal?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty grinned toothily."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty grinned toothily.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Oh, it's very safe to say that. Al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, it's very safe to say that. Although it does strike me that your opponent's proposal could be implemented in, say, the construction industry without too much difficulty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria's grip on her podium tightene..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria's grip on her podium tightened. Rusty stroked his chin faux-thoughtfully.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Come to think of it, I won't presu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come to think of it, I won't presume to speak up for the people in Madam Speaker's high-and-mighty 'circles'. I'm the only one who cared enough to show up today, right?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""So here's another thought. You reg..."
entries.dialogueText: "So here's another thought. You regulate Rizian industry however you want. But maybe, just maybe, you think about making an exception for old Rusty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He winked at me again. Manus drew a..."
entries.dialogueText: He winked at me again. Manus drew a hand across his brow.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Our proposal as it stands does not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our proposal as it stands does not allow for exceptions. The King may alter it as he sees fit, but the RPP refuses to do so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Giving *some* of the workers what..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving *some* of the workers what they want might divide them enough to head off organized dissent, right?"

entries.dialogueText: "But I'll just say this. There's no way we at RRG can keep filling your government's coffers if our hands are tied by unnecessary regulations."

entries.dialogueText: "Your proposal was never going to be accepted in its entirety, Mr. Sazon. Compromise is part of the political process."

entries.dialogueText: "I've witnessed Mr. Montoro's cavalier attitude towards employee safety. If any company needs to be regulated, it's RRG."

entries.dialogueText: "I don't agree with Mr. Montoro's arguments one bit. It doesn't make sense to regulate some industries and not others."

entries.dialogueText: Daria frowned.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""What it will do is hamper the majo..."
entries.dialogueText: "What it will do is hamper the majority of Rizian businesses while giving miners an unfair advantage."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""My party will not compromise when..."
entries.dialogueText: "My party will not compromise when human welfare is at stake."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""No, it does not.""

entries.dialogueText: "Cavalier? Heck, Your Majesty, you're the one who'd be putting men out of work with one decree."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo calmly spoke up."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo calmly spoke up.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The time for a vote is drawing clo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The time for a vote is drawing close. To be clear, Mr. Sazon, you do not wish to amend your proposal to take into account Mr. Montoro's comments?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Please do not forget in whose pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please do not forget in whose presence you're speaking, Mr. Montoro."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I do not, Your Grace. The King may..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not, Your Grace. The King may choose to accept or ignore them at will."

entries.dialogueText: "Rusty, did you have any closing arguments?"

entries.dialogueText: "This proposal would fail without you in this room. So I'd like to believe you've joined us for a reason."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He gave Manus a brusque nod. The opposition speaker didn't acknowledge it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Scandalized chatter broke out among..."
entries.dialogueText: Scandalized chatter broke out among the Delegates. Daria banged her gavel for silence.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Point is, there's no one-size-fits..."
entries.dialogueText: "Point is, there's no one-size-fits-all protocol for regulating what we do. The environment, the ore density, the tech being used -- it all varies, even within parts of the same mine."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""We're doing our best to keep our w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're doing our best to keep our workers safe on the job. But we also want them to go home with healthy paychecks."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're exaggerating.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're exaggerating."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about the miners who have bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the miners who have been speaking out? We cannot ignore their complaints."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Your Majesty, esteemed Delegates -..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, esteemed Delegates -- if we're forced to develop specialized protocols for every single nook and cranny of our business, we'll end up millions in the hole. Who even knows if anyone will be safer for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You could easily afford such measu..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could easily afford such measures if you forewent a portion of your own salary."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty chuckled to himself."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty chuckled to himself.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I beg your pardon, but half the pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg your pardon, but half the people in this room are sitting on fortunes just because they happen to have the right last name. Asking a hard-working commoner to give up the money he spent his life scraping for -- it doesn't sit right with me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""RRG takes care of our own, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "RRG takes care of our own, Your Majesty. We'll solve this within our company, like we always have."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hey, if you want to test my theory..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hey, if you want to test my theory, you're more than welcome to do so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That does seem much more complicat..."
entries.dialogueText: "That does seem much more complicated than Mr. Sazon made it out to be."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Yes, well, he's a noble. Sooner or..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, well, he's a noble. Sooner or later, he's got to butt heads with the way the world really works."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A quiet look of annoyance flashed a..."
entries.dialogueText: A quiet look of annoyance flashed across Daria's face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria cleared her throat."
entries.dialogueText: Daria cleared her throat.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The subject of noble wealth is har..."
entries.dialogueText: "The subject of noble wealth is hardly germane to this discussion."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And if we are to increase our stak..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if we are to increase our stake, it would behoove us not to damage RRG's profitability."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Passing a version that exempts RRG..."
entries.dialogueText: "Passing a version that exempts RRG makes practical sense, but would surely anger the nobles whose investments are affected."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As for his family, I don't believe..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for his family, I don't believe House Sazon had a hand in this proposal at all. They have as much to lose from it as the Azaros or Torases."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But I urge you to make the decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I urge you to make the decision that benefits Rizia, not Mr. Sazon or his party."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The young man does seem desperate..."
entries.dialogueText: "The young man does seem desperate to have you in his corner."

entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'm still curious how he found out..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm still curious how he found out that today's session was taking place. It would be most unlike Speaker de Rava to inform him."

entries.dialogueText: As we stepped outside the House of Delegates, I saw Manus Sazon waiting to greet us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm happy to have gotten a look in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy to have gotten a look into the inner workings of the House of Delegates. It was very enlightening indeed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My foremost concern is for the Riz..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're most welcome. We shall have..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're most welcome. We shall have to meet soon to discuss the next steps."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you aren't too disappointed..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you aren't too disappointed with the outcome."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I hope that means you'll continue..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope that means you'll continue to consider our proposals going forward."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You're welcome to attend as often..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're welcome to attend as often as you'd like."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I'm looking forward to it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to it."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Not at all. I see the merit in my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not at all. I see the merit in my opponents' arguments, and I understand your decision completely."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand completely. I'll make..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand completely. I'll make sure our future proposals are more economically feasible."
